scope: Original procedural room drawings. Real native Canvas/controlled DOM, declared CPU and synthetic lifecycle. No exact geometry or hardware certification.

checks.name: Exactly three existing RE7 IDs are opted in; 52 stage records and their routes are not enlarged
All three sets produce independent opaque frames with no dependency on remote images
Repeated time and time rewind reproduce exact pixels, regardless of draw order
Reduced motion freezes every animated layer and camera without hiding its room
Invalid time/camera values are bounded and never create stale or transparent margins
Architecture and three animation categories can be isolated without moving collision terrain
The combat floor stays pixel-stable while the ceiling and background animate
Exterior rain has explicit apertures; the testing corridor has no weather overlay
Unsupported IDs fail without painting, clearing or allocating stage state
Context transforms, alpha, stroke state and inputs are restored after every drawing
Renderer code has no wall-clock, mutable random generator, timers, audio or save channel
Every HTML renderer entry point loads the same optional R14 module before drawing
Workshop exposes the selected real room, five layer choices and original 52 configurations
Seek, step and share link restore the chosen room/layer/frame in pause
Invalid deep links do not import a camera, life, stage file or unknown layer
Empty search removes stale links and reduced-motion prevents automatic playback
Focus loss and simulated persisted lifecycle retain one paused loop and exact frame
Real renderer preloads procedural rooms, and a missing module still uses preserved original art
Rendering each new room cannot change full CPU-duel state or consume simulation random numbers
Unchanged datasets, audio, actor clips and all replay contracts match the exact R13 snapshot
